title: Riveting (1918)
description:
Riveting. Location of events unknown.



Workers riveting a large pipe; one man outside with the riveter and the other man on the inside of the pipe; others stand nearby.  CU on the man riveting; holding the tool up to each hole; as the other guy reaches into the pipe with another tool. Then a shot of a group of workers; patting one man on the back and shaking their hats.                               
 FILM ID:1892.23
